items.title: Are US automakers' concerns of domestic Chinese competition overblown?
items.summary: Ahead of President Trump's meeting with China's Xi Jinping this week, US auto groups signaled their concerns about growing competition from Chinese automakers in a new letter to the administration. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian examine automakers' worries of Chinese competition penetrating into the US market.

items.title: Did Trump Snub Ford? The Stock Dips Ahead of Dinner With Xi.
items.summary: GM and Tesla CEOs are expected to attend a dinner with President Trump and President Xi. Ford, apparently, wasn’t invited.

items.title: Trump’s State Dinner Makes Strange Bedfellows of Tesla’s Elon Musk and GM’s Mary Barra
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping is coming to America to visit U.S. President Donald Trump.  The two men will dine at the White House on Thursday evening with many U.S. business leaders in attendance, including  General Motors  CEO Mary Barra and  Tesla  CEO Elon Musk, according to Reuters.  GM and Tesla didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment about the dinner.
